data.text:
Mukesh Rathore vs Union Of India on 8 April, 2024 
Author: Subodh Abhyankar
Bench: Subodh Abhyankar
 1
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE SUBODH ABHYANKAR  ON THE 8 th OF APRIL, 2024  WRIT PETITION No. 7680 of 2024  BETWEEN:-
 MUKESH RATHORE S/O ASHOK RATHORE  OCCUPATION: BUSINESS SENDHWA, TEHSIL SENDHWA  DISTRICT BARWANI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 ..
 (BY SHRI AKSHAT SHARMA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  1. UNION OF INDIA SECRETARY MINISTRY OF  COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY PETROLEUM AND  EXPLOSIVE SAFETY ORGANISATION (PESO) E-7/77,
 II FLOOR, LALA LAJPAT RAI SOCIETY, NEAR 12  NUMBER BUS STOP, ARERA COLONY, BHOPAL  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 2. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  PRINCIPAL SECRETARY DEPARTMENT OF FOOD  CIVIL SUPPLIERS AND CONSUMER PROTECTION  VALLABH BHAWAN BHOPAL (MADHYA PRADESH)
 3. COLLECTOR BARWANI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 4 . SUB DIVISIONAL OFFICER REVENUE SENDHWA  DIST BARWANI (MADHYA PRADESH) 
 .....
 (BY MS. SURBHI BAHEL - ADVOCATE FOR RESPONDENT NO.1/UOI AND  MS. PRANJALI YAJURVEDI - P.L. FOR STATE)
 This petition coming on for admission this day, th e co  following:
 ORDER 1. Heard.
Mukesh Rathore vs Union Of India on 8 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71472444/
1 2. This writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed by the petitioner seeking the following reliefs:-
"a) To allow this petition by issuing appropriate writ, direction or order, and to direct the Collector, Khargone to conclude the proceedings of Case No. 0083/B- 121/2023-24, without any further delay and decide the matter in accordance with law; and b) Anyother relief which this Court may deem fit in favour of the petitioner in the interest of justice."
3. The grievance of the petitioner is that the petitioner's godown has been seized by the Collector before whom Case No.083/B-121/2023-24 is still pending, which is causing extremely hardship to the petitioner. 
4. Counsel for the State submits that the case shall be decided at an early date. 
5. In view of the same, the petition is disposed of with a direction to the Collector, Khargone to decide the petitioner's case as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of two months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, by a reasoned and speaking order, in accordance with law. 
6. It is made clear that this Court has not reflected upon the merits of the case. 
7. With the aforesaid, the petition stands disposed of. 
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Pankaj Mukesh Rathore vs Union Of India on 8 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71472444/
